text: I'd like you to make a coffee ad campaign, with three versions that all feel like they belong together. I always associate coffee with a little reset in the morning, which is why I'm excited about this. For the sizes, I need square 1:1, vertical 9:16 and wide 16:9, and the words should be exactly “Daybreak Coffee”, “Fresh start. Better coffee.” and “Shop now”. Please use a steaming coffee cup with cream and dark green colours. Keep the same campaign design across all three, just rearranged to fit each format.
